title: Production of Clarified Tissue Extract (CTE)
author: Christina M. M. Ferreira
materials: Transport samples on ice packs to the laboratory.

steps.title: Prepare and Inspect Tomatoes
steps.instruction: Harvest or purchase tomatoes at the preferred stage of development and discard any with visible damage.

steps.title: Surface Sterilize Tomatoes
steps.instruction: Sterilize the tomato surfaces within a laminar flow biosafety cabinet.

substeps.instruction: Place individual tomatoes spaced apart on sterile aluminum foil.
Spray 70% ethanol directly onto the surface.
Manually agitate by rubbing with gloved hands (cleaned with 70% ethanol) every 2–3 minutes for 15 minutes.
Rinse by immersing twice in sterile deionized water, using a fresh bath each time.

steps.title: Aseptically Dice Tomatoes
steps.instruction: Cut the sterilized tomatoes into segments using flame-sterilized knives on a sanitized cutting board.

substeps.instruction: Cut tomatoes into ~1-inch segments (peeling is not required unless specified).
Transfer segments to a sterile pan and cover with sterile foil.

steps.title: Freeze and Thaw Tissue
steps.instruction: Perform a freeze-thaw cycle to promote cellular disruption.

substeps.instruction: Store samples at −80 °C for ≥48 hours.
Transfer frozen samples to 30 °C and thaw overnight to ambient temperature.

steps.title: Homogenize Tissue
steps.instruction: Create a uniform slurry using a sterile blender.

substeps.instruction: Transfer thawed tissue in batches (based on blender carafe fill line) using a sterile scoop/spoon.
Process at high speed for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Perform Coarse Filtration
steps.instruction: Remove large particulates from the homogenized slurry using a vacuum filtration setup.

substeps.instruction: Place a large Buchner filter funnel over a 4L side-arm flask and seal the connection with Parafilm.
Line the funnel with four layers of sterile Grade 90 cheesecloth.
Apply vacuum to the flask.
Filter the homogenized slurry and collect the filtrate in the flask.

steps.title: Clarify Extract via Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Separate remaining particulates from the filtrate.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot the filtrate into 50 mL conical tubes.
Centrifuge at 25,500 × g for 30 minutes.
Collect and pool the supernatants.

steps.title: Store and Aliquot Clarified Extract
steps.instruction: Preserve the clarified tissue extract (CTE) to minimize freeze-thaw cycles.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot the pooled clarified filtrate into sterile, appropriately sized containers.
Store aliquoted extract at −20 °C or below.

steps.title: Prepare Extract for Downstream Use
steps.instruction: Thaw and handle the stored extract carefully.

substeps.instruction: Thaw the extract at 4 °C overnight.
Allow the sample to remain undisturbed after thawing to preserve stratified or dissociated material.
Do not use samples thawed for longer than 48 hours.

steps.title: Perform Fine Vacuum Filtration
steps.instruction: Further clarify the extract using a glass fiber wool filtration assembly.

substeps.instruction: Remove the plunger from a 100 mL syringe.
Tightly pack the syringe barrel with sterile glass fiber wool until full.
Place the packed syringe onto the top of a glass powder funnel.
Place the glass powder funnel onto a 1 L side-arm flask and seal the junction with Parafilm.
Apply vacuum to secure the syringe and initiate filtration.
Pour the pooled supernatant into the syringe, adding additional glass fiber wool as needed to keep the syringe fully packed.
